mostWorthwhile.text: Building living supporting tissue from fibroblasts and their secreted matrix made the relationship between cells and extracellular material clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final muscle protein-production step echoed the fibroblast branch, so it felt somewhat repetitive, even though the comparison reinforced the role of different RNA messages.

surprise.text: The supporting tissue included living fibroblasts linked to material they had produced, rather than just a collagen bundle.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though combining fibroblasts with a matrix they had already secreted felt a little mechanical as a separate tissue-building step.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how the separate myoblasts develop into mature muscle fibres; the chapter leaves that process open. Some terms, such as paraxial mesoderm, would benefit from explanation.
